headline: World War One finally ends
post_facts: Over 116,000 Americans died in the war

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in nineteen eighteen... the guns of World War One fell silent.

scenes.label: France, 1918
scenes.caption: U.S. 64th Regiment celebrates the armistice
scenes.text: [warmly] American soldiers in France cheered the armistice.

scenes.label: American lives lost in the war
scenes.text: [softly] The war had cost more than one hundred sixteen thousand American lives.

scenes.label: Back home
scenes.caption: The Celebration of Armistice Day, by Arthur C. Goodwin
scenes.title: Crowds filled the streets
scenes.text: [warmly] Back home, crowds filled the streets.

scenes.title: From Armistice Day to Veterans Day
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] The date became Armistice Day... and later, Veterans Day.

scenes.title: Which veteran are you thinking of?
scenes.text: [gently] Which veteran are you thinking of today?
